messages:
maria: Quick sync — I want to land a small follow-up to the warmup RFC: we need a concrete telemetry + contract spec so Dedicated/Private runtimes can validate that fallback policies actually do the right thing.

maria: Problem: we currently infer success from 'no OOMs' and coarse p95 latencies. that's fragile for sharded safetensors + partial warmup. we need signals that indicate warmup quality per-shard and per-request.

alex: Agreed. My proposal: emit a small set of typed events from the loader/warmup layer: shard_fetch_latency, shard_hit_rate, kv_cache_fill, checksum_mismatch, partial_stream_fallback. keep them cheap (aggregated counters + p50/p95 windows). :+1:

sam: +1 on the names. Also add prefetch_score (0-1) that the planner sets when it decides to fetch eagerly. That lets routing pick models/variants with higher prefetch confidence.

jess: For consumer contracts, we should expose an API on the control plane: GET /warmup-status?model=... returns per-shard {hit_rate, avg_fetch_ms, errors, last_prefetch_score}. runtime can decide to fallback if hit_rate < T or errors > N.

maria: Good — let's define thresholds as defaults but make them configurable per-tenant. e.g., hit_rate < 0.6 -> consider model-variant degraded; p95_fetch_ms > 200ms -> increase parallel prefetching or fallback.

alex: Edge cases: cold starts where no telemetry exists. Suggest ephemeral policy: on first N minutes rely on conservative routing (prefer quantized variants?) and emit 'cold_start' flag until either hit_rate stabilizes or token count threshold reached.

sam: Also need to ensure we can correlate telemetry to requests for debugging: include request_id prefix mapping -> shard_ids touched. Keep the mapping lightweight (sampled).

jess: For implementation: instrument the loader to emit zstreams to our telemetry pipeline with small schema. Example event (pseudo):

```
WARMUP_METRIC
shard_id: 42
metric: shard_hit_rate
value: 0.73
window_s: 60
model: redwood/v1
node: gpu-17
```

maria: Nice. Two operational asks: 1) surface warmup heatmaps in Console per-model (shard rows x time columns), 2) an alert when fallback triggers > X% of requests over Y minutes.

alex: Implementation note: ensure metrics are emitted even when warmup is disabled (so the control plane can detect that warmup isn't wired up). Emit a special metric warmup_enabled=false.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: warmup-telemetry collector chart updated in staging (PR 4321). will run for 48h smoke.

sam: Open questions: should fallback contracts be static (hit_rate-based) or ML-driven (predictive regressions)? My vote: start static for reliability, add ML signal later.

maria: Agreed. Action items: alex -> draft metric schema + default thresholds; jess -> sketch control-plane API and Console heatmap wireframe; sam -> sampling plan for request->shard mapping; i'll coordinate rollout and docs.

alex: I'll drop a PR with proto definitions and a short compatibility doc.

jess: I'll mock the heatmap in figma and post link later.

maria: Thanks all — small follow-up RFC sgtm once the PRs land. :shipit:
